title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Endangering Drug Safety

articles.content_en:
Article 5: Where any person produces, sells, or provides substandard drugs under any of the circumstances specified in Article 1 of this Interpretation, a severe punishment shall be imposed as the circumstances warrant.
Where any person produces, sells, or provides substandard drugs under any of the circumstances specified in Article 2 of this Interpretation, it shall be deemed as 'causing serious harm to human health' as prescribed in Article 142 of the Criminal Law.
Where any person produces, sells, or provides substandard drugs causing death, or under any of the circumstances specified in subparagraphs (1) to (5) of Article 4 of this Interpretation, it shall be deemed as 'especially serious consequences' as prescribed in Article 142 of the Criminal Law.

Article 6: Any person who, for the purpose of producing, selling, or providing counterfeit drugs or substandard drugs, synthesizes, refines, extracts, stores, processes, or prepares pharmaceutical raw materials, or who carries out batching, mixing, formulation, storage, or packaging in the process of turning pharmaceutical raw materials, excipients, or packaging materials into finished products, shall be deemed as 'producing' as prescribed in Articles 141 and 142 of the Criminal Law.
Where a drug use unit or its staff, knowing that the drugs are counterfeit or substandard, supplies them to others for a fee, it shall be deemed as 'selling' as prescribed in Articles 141 and 142 of the Criminal Law; where the supply is without charge, it shall be deemed as 'providing' as prescribed in Articles 141 and 142 of the Criminal Law.

Article 11: Where any person, for the purpose of supplying others with production, sale, or provision of drugs, violates state regulations by producing or selling raw materials or excipients that do not meet pharmaceutical requirements, and the act conforms to the provisions of Article 140 of the Criminal Law, the person shall be given a heavier punishment for the crime of producing or selling counterfeit or substandard products; if the act also constitutes any other crime, the conviction and punishment shall be in accordance with the provisions for the heavier punishment.

Article 12: Where any advertiser, advertising agent, or advertising publisher violates state regulations by using advertisements to make false propaganda about drugs, and the circumstances are serious, the person shall be convicted and punished for the crime of false advertising in accordance with Article 222 of the Criminal Law.

Article 13: Where any person, knowing that drugs were purchased through medical insurance fraud, illegally acquires or sells such drugs, and the amount is 50,000 yuan or more, the person shall be convicted and punished for the crime of concealing or disguising the proceeds of crime in accordance with Article 312 of the Criminal Law. Where any person directs, instigates, or induces another person to purchase drugs through medical insurance fraud, and subsequently illegally acquires or sells such drugs, if the act conforms to the provisions of Article 266 of the Criminal Law, the person shall be convicted and punished for the crime of fraud.
Whether criminal liability shall be investigated against an actor who purchases drugs through medical insurance fraud shall be determined appropriately according to law based on a comprehensive consideration of specific case circumstances such as the amount of fraudulently obtained medical insurance funds, means, and attitude of admission and repentance. Whether or not the actor who purchases drugs through medical insurance fraud is investigated for criminal liability shall not affect the conviction and punishment of the actor who illegally acquires or sells the relevant drugs.
The subjective knowledge specified in the first paragraph shall be determined comprehensively based on drug markings, acquisition channels, prices, scale, drug traceability information, and other relevant factors.

Article 14: Where any state organ staff member responsible for drug safety supervision and administration abuses power or neglects duties, constituting the crime of dereliction of duty in drug regulation, and also constitutes other dereliction of duty crimes such as the crime of engaging in fraudulent practices in commodity inspection for personal gain or the crime of dereliction of duty in commodity inspection, the conviction and punishment shall be in accordance with the provisions for the heavier punishment.
Where any state organ staff member responsible for drug safety supervision and administration abuses power or neglects duties, not constituting the crime of dereliction of duty in drug regulation, but constituting other dereliction of duty crimes as prescribed in the preceding paragraph, the person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with such other crime.
Where any state organ staff member responsible for drug safety supervision and administration conspires with another person, using the convenience of their position to assist the other person in committing a crime endangering drug safety, and the act simultaneously constitutes a dereliction of duty crime and being an accomplice to a crime endangering drug safety, the person shall be convicted and given a heavier punishment in accordance with the provisions for the heavier punishment.

Article 15: For a person convicted of the crime of producing, selling, or providing counterfeit drugs, the crime of producing, selling, or providing substandard drugs, or the crime of obstructing drug administration, a fine shall be imposed according to law based on the defendant's amount of crime and illegal gains, with comprehensive consideration of the defendant's ability to pay the fine. The fine shall generally be not less than twice the amount of the drugs produced, sold, or provided; in the case of a joint crime, the total fine imposed on all joint offenders shall generally be not less than twice the amount of the drugs produced, sold, or provided.

Article 16: For a person convicted of the crime of producing, selling, or providing counterfeit drugs, the crime of producing, selling, or providing substandard drugs, or the crime of obstructing drug administration, the application of probation and exemption from criminal punishment shall be strictly controlled in accordance with the conditions prescribed in the Criminal Law. Where criminal punishment is imposed, a professional prohibition or restraining order may be issued according to law based on the circumstances of the crime and the need to prevent recidivism. Where otherwise provided by laws or administrative regulations such as the Drug Administration Law of the People's Republic of China, such provisions shall prevail.
Where a person who is not prosecuted or is exempted from criminal punishment requires administrative penalties, disciplinary sanctions, or other sanctions, the case shall be transferred to the relevant competent authority for handling according to law.

Article 17: Where a unit commits the crime of producing, selling, or providing counterfeit drugs, the crime of producing, selling, or providing substandard drugs, or the crime of obstructing drug administration, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the directly responsible supervisor and other directly responsible persons shall be punished in accordance with the conviction and sentencing standards for natural persons stipulated in this Interpretation.
Where a unit commits a crime, the total fine imposed on the defendant unit and its directly responsible supervisor and other directly responsible persons shall generally be not less than twice the amount of the drugs produced, sold, or provided.

Article 18: Where a person privately processes or sells drugs according to a folk traditional formula, the quantity is small, and no harm to others or delay in diagnosis or treatment is caused; or where a person, without profit-making purpose, carries out acts of producing, importing, or selling drugs of a self-help or mutual-aid nature, such acts shall not be deemed as crimes.
Where it is difficult to determine whether a formula is a folk traditional formula, the determination shall be made based on the expert opinion issued by the drug regulatory authority at or above the prefecture level or other relevant authorities, combined with other evidence.

Article 19: The terms 'counterfeit drugs' and 'substandard drugs' as used in Articles 141 and 142 of the Criminal Law shall be determined in accordance with the provisions of the Drug Administration Law of the People's Republic of China.
For counterfeit drugs or substandard drugs as specified in subparagraphs (2) and (4) of paragraph 2 and subparagraphs (3) to (6) of paragraph 3 of Article 98 of the Drug Administration Law of the People's Republic of China, where a judgment can be made based on the raw materials and packaging seized on site, combined with evidence materials such as the confessions of the criminal suspect or defendant, the drug regulatory authority at or above the prefecture level may issue an expert opinion. Where counterfeit drugs or substandard drugs are determined pursuant to other provisions of paragraph 2 or paragraph 3 of Article 98 of the Drug Administration Law of the People's Republic of China, or where there is a dispute as to whether the drugs fall under subparagraph (2) of paragraph 2 or subparagraph (6) of paragraph 3 of Article 98, a drug testing institution established or designated by the drug regulatory authority at or above the provincial level shall conduct testing and issue a quality testing conclusion. The judicial authorities shall make a determination based on the expert opinion, the testing conclusion, and other evidence.

Article 20: The amount of drugs produced or provided shall be calculated based on the value of the drugs; the amount of drugs sold shall be calculated based on all illegal income obtained and obtainable.

Article 21: This Interpretation shall come into force on March 6, 2022. Upon the promulgation and implementation of this Interpretation, the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Handling of Criminal Cases Endangering Drug Safety (Fa Shi [2014] No. 14) and the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Handling of Criminal Cases of Falsification of Materials for Drug and Medical Device Registration Applications (Fa Shi [2017] No. 15) shall be abolished simultaneously.
